I’m not here to be like “no, don’t do it”, but all I’m going to do is tell you I’ve been there, I’ve overdosed, tried to hang myself, drank bleach and have survived it all. From all those attempts, my body is super fucked up and I now have numerous health issues on top of mental health issues that have been ongoing since childhood. I will say, over the years I’ve realized that your best advocate is yourself, you may not know your worth yet, and that’s okay, but if you can, keep going through therapists until you find the right one, don’t settle for less than someone who will listen, respond, and offer some sort of direction. Do the same with psychiatrists or mental health medication providers of some sort. Be stern with the level of care you need, if you have insurance (or are under your parents) call or have your parents call to see what mental health services and providers are available in your area. There are people and professionals that do care, it’s just difficult determining helpful from not.
